notes.title: MarbleGP does now support Track Packs
notes.notes: MarbleGP does now support Track Packs which can be created with the MarbleGP Track Editor (in development)

notes.title: Graphics fix for AMD chips
notes.notes: I have fixed a problem which was reported several times: the shaders for the in-game graphics did not work on AMD cards. This is fixed with the latest update (I hope)

notes.title: Fixed network gaming
notes.notes: Yesterday I realized that the network gaming is not working at all. This is now fixed, the feature does now work (but needs a stable network connection)
